title: Privacy-preserving query-sample export
description: A sample of queries, one row per query, carrying exactly what the prompt-literacy rubric consumes to compute a grade and nothing else. A row states either a short prompt excerpt for browser-local classification or a category the producer already assigned — never both, never neither. Excerpts are classified in the reader's tab and discarded there; only the derived category label and the token counts survive the classification step.

bucket_granularity.description: The time granularity every record's query_date states. Day is the only accepted value in 1.0: the rubric weights each sampled query once and reports no time series, so an hour bucket would carry a precision the grade cannot use and the redaction boundary would rather not hold.

classification_site.description: Where a prompt_excerpt is turned into a category. The one accepted value says it happens in the reader's own browser tab and the excerpt is discarded there.

org_unit_id.description: The HRIS org contract's unit_id, byte-for-byte and with the same pseudonym construction, so a sample joins the org tree without introducing a second notion of department. Compared verbatim: no case folding, no trimming beyond the surrounding whitespace a delimited reader strips, and no canonical form other than the one the HRIS producer emitted.

query_date.description: The UTC calendar day this query fell in, as YYYY-MM-DD, validated against the real calendar. Same field type and format as the provider-usage contract's usage_date, so a sample and a billing aggregate bucket alike. Never a per-request instant.

model_raw.description: The model identifier exactly as the gateway or provider log emitted it. Same field name, meaning, and verbatim rule as the provider-usage-billing v1.1 record. Bounded to the conservative identifier shape the rubric declares in its redaction block, so the one string-valued field that passes through cannot carry prompt text.

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens for this one query. Same field name as the provider-usage-billing v1.1 record, but a required non-negative integer rather than that contract's absent-or-count: a single query is not an aggregate that may fold rows naming different models, so there is nothing for null to mean here.

output_tokens.description: Completion tokens for this one query, under the same rule as input_tokens.

prompt_excerpt.description: A short excerpt of the request, present only when the producer has not classified the row. It is read by the classifier in the reader's tab and discarded there; it is never persisted, never transmitted, and never copied into a result, a derived record, or an error message.

category.description: A category the producer already assigned, from the closed vocabulary of prompt-literacy rubric 1.0.0. Present only when the row carries no excerpt.
